Mercuryo is a fiat-to-crypto payment service that lets users buy cryptocurrency with bank cards. Mercuryo is operated by a centralized company that acts as an intermediary in these purchases.

Simplex is a fiat-to-crypto payment service that lets users buy cryptocurrency with bank cards. Simplex is operated by a centralized company that acts as an intermediary in these purchases.

Binance Bridge is a cross-chain bridge that transfers assets between blockchains. Binance Bridge is operated by the centralized exchange Binance, which acts as an intermediary.

Trezor Suite Lite is a lightweight interface for managing cryptocurrency held on Trezor hardware wallets. Trezor Suite Lite is non-custodial, so users keep control of their own keys.

Yoroi is a non-custodial light wallet for the Cardano blockchain. Yoroi is developed by Emurgo and supports ADA and Cardano native tokens.
